gates.required_evidence: Two real collector/HTTP/SQL rounds: four correlated spans, private metrics, deduplicated stale/clear alerts, redaction, no published collector ports, terminal commit during collector outage.

Two real HTTP/SQL/inbox/process rounds: crash after durable inbox commit, deduplicated replay, independent event authorization, exact global/tenant UTF-8 counters, byte-exhaustion rejection, owned retainer stopped before synthetic aging, managed retention and idempotent cancellation.

Two original complete rounds, each with 44 RAG checks; 129 locked shard/request candidates and orphan FK isolation; four phases of 128 real accepted requests, zero lost/duplicate terminal IDs, >=99% SUCCEEDED, drain within 180s (broker/cache outage 120s), PostgreSQL ready within <60s from SIGKILL, migration under a live row lock, Decimal counter reconciliation and restore to separate owned instance/volume.

Two owned Redis expiration rounds. Live subsecond key and SCAN-expired key pass; persistent, overlong, malformed and unknown TTL controls fail. Delete only exact generated fixture keys; preserve volumes. Current script expects eval/runs output, so Central must adapt this allowlisted output check to .local before execution.

Two retained QA-volume start/stop cycles: TCP health, real restored databases, unchanged database/volume fingerprints, durability settings on, 120s clean stop, no OOM. Setup deadline remains 480s; live PostgreSQL SIGKILL RTO remains <60s.

Define the original workload and acceptance/SLO targets before execution. Reconcile each offered key, HTTP classification, accepted ID, terminal, deadline and delivery. The existing offered-load fixture uses one Ana identity and explicitly cannot certify 100000 successful workflows or the production policy's 100-tenant workload. Provisioning a legitimate synthetic 100-tenant admission surface is a Central/shared-file dependency.

Prove externally supervised process persistence, integrated migration execution, backup/restore integrity, failover with fencing on an independent host/failure domain, and the real identity/TLS/security/release gate. One-host synthetic tests and production-disabled startup are insufficient for this approval.
